title: The Quick, Draw! Dataset
blurb: 240 doodles from Google’s Quick, Draw! game, where strangers had 20 seconds to draw a cat, a clock, a moon, a bicycle, a sun, a fish, a snail or a donut. Pixels versus DINOv2.

notes.neighbors: Pixels think two doodles are close when their lines happen to land on the same squares. DINOv2 cares more about what they are drawings of. They rarely agree.
notes.dimension: Pixels claim far more dimensions than DINOv2: scribbles vary in every direction, while the model squeezes them onto a few meaningful axes.

about.name: The Quick, Draw! Dataset
